description: This file is a shell script for testing Git operations related to applying patches that involve type changes such as renames, directory/file transformations, symlinks, and binary files. It sets up a repository, executes various patch applications, and verifies correctness.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test that expects success, executes a series of shell commands, and verifies the outcome.

methods.name: test_debug
methods.description: Outputs debug information, such as the contents of patches.

methods.name: test_ln_s_add
methods.description: Creates a symbolic link and adds it to the index.
